title: fix(update): run task-delivery orphan recovery at update admission instead of refusing
body:
Refs #142586 #145284

Follows the landed Doctor recovery in #145284. This PR reuses that preservation owner for update admission.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running `openclaw update` would be refused before Doctor could recover orphan `task_delivery_state` rows. Creating update history required a clean foreign-key check, so the updater could never reach the supported recovery.

## Why This Change Was Made

Integrity checks distinguish the exact cascade-owned task-delivery relation with typed relation, parent-table, and orphan-count metadata. Classification still refuses unresolved state and grants no write authority; other foreign-key violations and structural damage remain refusals.

Actual update admission invokes the existing preservation-first recovery under its ownership fence and immediate transaction. Foreign-key actions stay disabled so inbound dependents cannot cascade away. Removal and the ledger's recovery step commit together, recording the count and recovery directory. The receipt and its backup locator survive both step-count eviction and byte-budget compaction; optional progress diagnostics remain disposable. Preview intent reaches the writer: `--dry-run` reports repair guidance without recovering rows or creating history for that refused preview. Doctor uses the same integrity classifier.

Recovery reads `task_delivery_state` and checks parent existence in `task_runs`; it deletes only delivery rows whose task is missing under the declared `ON DELETE CASCADE` relation. It never recreates parents, replays deliveries, or deletes valid siblings. Before removal, the existing Doctor owner preserves a verified WAL-aware full database copy plus a lossless export of every removed row in the recovery directory. Admission records the count and directory in the existing `update_runs.steps_json` column in the same transaction. No schema, version, or row-shape changes are made, so older readers retain their existing schema contract.

## User Impact

A fixed updater preserves and recovers these known orphan rows before recording an update. If it cannot acquire repair authority or preserve the data, its refusal identifies the repairable condition and directs the operator to `openclaw doctor --fix`. Recovery does not reconstruct tasks or replay deliveries. Ordinary backups continue refusing unrepaired foreign-key violations.

## Evidence

- Before admission was wired to recovery, the 18-orphan boundary regression failed at `assertExistingOpenClawStateSchema`; afterward admission succeeds, the valid sibling survives, the verified database copy and exact row export exist, and the ledger records recovery.
- A separate preview regression failed with a resolved `admitted` result before preview intent was propagated; afterward all 18 rows remain, with no recovery artifact or history row.
- State database: 198 passed, one existing skip. Integrity: 29 passed. Doctor schema preflight: 8 passed. Existing admission: 20 passed. State migration and ledger suites: 162 passed. Database-open controls: 16 passed.
- After integrating main and #145284: all 9 admission controls and the ordinary-backup refusal regression passed. Controls include inbound `CASCADE` and `SET NULL`, ledger-refusal rollback, read-only stores, foreign Gateway ownership, non-cascade violations, and structural damage.
- [Exact-head CI run 34663912517](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34663912517) targets `78cb3233231fb6903bef39e4a1044f58fb20dcdd`. After the bounded watcher and 12 fallback polls: 132 passing checks, three inherited new-session UI failures, and `checks-windows-node-test-2` still running. All production and test typecheck lanes passed; the tsgo shard-cap failure did not recur.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs` passed with dependencies aligned to main's frozen lockfile. The full build and integrated CI artifact build passed, including SDK declarations; package tarball integrity and import-graph checks passed.
- Installed main-candidate → same main-candidate passed on Linux/Node 24.19.0 using one unchanged sealed package. Preview retained all 18 orphan rows and created no history. The actual update completed the global install, candidate canary, package swap, and Doctor; foreign-key checks were clean afterward, the verified backup retained all 18 original rows, and the successful ledger row recorded the recovery count and directory.
- Matrix command: `openclaw update --yes --no-restart --tag <same-sealed-candidate.tgz> --json`. Package SHA-256: `7110c0a6be2bd67d48f2429c4363671a001db9f390bdbc4a1ec870cb7405b3fa`.

### Receipt retention regression

`node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/update-cli/update-command-task-delivery.test.ts -t 'retains the recovery receipt'` failed on `672e8f4ffac283f13cb45d056519c480bd2cbbfe`:

```text
step count / diagnostic bytes / retained step bytes: 3 failed
AssertionError: expected undefined to match object
{ status: 'completed', detail: StringContaining '18 orphan task delivery rows' }
```

After the codec fix, `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/update-cli/update-command-task-delivery.test.ts src/infra/update-run-ledger.test.ts` passed all 12 admission and 37 ledger tests. Each retention case reopens the database, finds the recovery count and backup directory, and verifies both the 128-step and 16 KiB bounds. The focused P2 review found no actionable findings. `node scripts/check-changed.mjs` passed for the follow-up. Receipt-retention head: `78cb3233231fb6903bef39e4a1044f58fb20dcdd`.

CI's merge with main `3ccc3710bd6390435311af5bcf8dcdd74b867892` has these unrelated failures; this PR changes none of the affected UI files:

- `check-lint-core-2`: `ui/src/pages/new-session/where-chip.test.ts` has 1,020 counted lines against the 1,000-line limit.
- `check-dependencies`: unused `renderConnectMachineMenuItem` and `renderCloudConfiguration` exports in `ui/src/pages/new-session/cloud-target.ts`.
- `checks-node-compact-large-5`: `ui/src/styles/cursor-policy.node.test.ts:83` rejects `.new-session-page__touch-details` in `new-session.css`.

### Installed Linux controls

All cells use Linux/Node 24.19.0 and the sealed main-candidate package above (built at `672e8f4ffac283f13cb45d056519c480bd2cbbfe`). The receipt-retention delta is independently covered by the fresh regressions above.

| Installed driver and state | Target | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Published npm 2026.9.4, 18 orphan delivery rows | Sealed main candidate | Expected exit 1 at installed-driver admission: `SQLite foreign_key_check failed ... task_delivery_state row 1 references task_runs`. All 18 orphans remain; zero update rows and recovery artifacts; installed driver unchanged. |
| Main candidate, 18 orphan delivery rows | Same sealed main candidate | Passed: full update, canary, swap, and Doctor; zero remaining orphans; 18 rows preserved in the backup; successful ledger with count and directory. |
| Main candidate, fresh profile with no state directory or configuration | Same sealed main candidate | Passed: actual update succeeded and created one successful history row; zero recovery steps or artifacts. Recovery is a no-op for a new profile. |

The published driver came from `https://registry.npmjs.org/openclaw/-/openclaw-2026.9.4.tgz`, verified against npm's SHA-512 integrity metadata; SHA-256 `4f1f656770461d4677dea755b1899cba12b912b06798c89a59e2f0c18688b761`. The control command was `openclaw update --yes --no-restart --tag <sealed-candidate.tgz> --json`.

## Known gaps

- Installed 2026.9.4 still refuses at its own admission: install the corrective release manually, then run `openclaw doctor --fix`. The published-driver control above proves this first-hop boundary; candidate recovery cannot run before that refusal.
- Recovery-only; producer tracked in #142586. The original orphan-producing sequence and recurrence prevention are outside this PR.

Thanks to @GitHoubi for the report and 9.4 reproduction, and @fuller-stack-dev for the preservation-first Doctor recovery in #145284.

## ClawSweeper review

The final review of `78cb3233231fb6903bef39e4a1044f58fb20dcdd` rates the patch diamond lobster and reports no actionable code findings. Its generic data-model compatibility checkbox is satisfied by the installed upgrade controls, unchanged schema/version/row-shape contract above, and explicit maintainer acceptance at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/145312#issuecomment-5641214670. No additional matrix or code fixup was needed. Preview and receipt-retention findings are resolved; the published-driver corrective-install boundary and recovery-only scope in #142586 remain documented. No manual re-review was requested because code was unchanged.

Landing verification: the exact-head watcher reported GREEN for [CI run 34667372296](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34667372296); native review-artifact validation, hosted CI/Testbox preparation, and merge verification passed. The approved head landed as `011b7dd2040acacee4f2c8e4b8697bb259f46322`.
